title.says: What the function is called, as it is offered to be called.

says.says: What it gathers, in a sentence.

takes.says: What it is given, each in turn: a set, any number of sets, words, a store's key, or an axis to group by; nothing unless it says.

native.says: For one of glass's own, the name the engine evaluates it by.

gives.says: For a function of one's own, the expression it gives, each argument it was given named as { arg: i }.

from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.

body.says: A function, as field/types/function.json declares it, carried here until the field joins the union; the two are one type to be merged by id when it does.

title.says: The statistic in a few words.

says.says: What it measures and why, in prose: the statistic is its prose as much as its expression.

gives.says: The expression that gives it, evaluated over the store wherever it is drawn; its result is never kept.

drawn.says: How it is best looked at: a number, a table by kind, a matrix, a landscape by height.

status.says: proposed, until the functions it calls are built.

body.says: A statistic over the field, declared as functional data: prose and an expression, drawn whenever looked at, so it is always of the store as it stands and nothing derived goes stale.

body.title: Count
body.says: How many holons the set given holds.

body.title: Measure
body.says: For each holon of the set given, a number along an axis: held, how many parts it holds; pointed, how many point at it; depth, how far below a whole given it first stands; words, how many words it reaches.

body.title: Overlap
body.says: For sets given in turn, how much each pair shares: what both reach over what either reaches.

body.title: Within
body.says: Everything the holons given hold, all the way down.

body.title: Holons by kind
body.says: How the field is made: every holon counted under its type, the first view of any store or union.

body.title: Held arity
body.says: For each kind, how many parts its holons hold: where the field branches wide, as a sentence into words, and where it is thin, as a paragraph that is mostly one sentence.
body.drawn: a table by kind, median and most

body.title: Lexeme arity
body.says: How many words point at each word as one: most words are said once, a few run through everything.
body.drawn: a spread, and its longest tail named

body.title: Utterances by shared words
body.says: Which of the author's utterances meet in the same words: the near relation within an utterance set against the far relation across them.
body.drawn: a matrix, its diagonal each utterance's own words

body.title: Branches by what they hold
body.says: How far apart isolated readings stand over the same held space: what two branches both hold over what either holds.
body.drawn: a matrix, read along model and seed

body.title: What matters by height
body.says: For each branch, what its understandings say matters, gathered by how far below the top they stand: the variable as it changes with ascension and descension.
